teacher_info.introduction:
I specialize in teaching IELTS and have developed a range of materials to help students to achieve their goals. I have a structured approach to increasing your band score, but it can be adapted depending on the amount of time you have to achieve your goal. 

I have had a lot of success teaching writing and speaking to students on Italki. The speaking lessons will elevate your ability in fluency, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation. During your first class, I will give you a practice speaking test and provide detailed feedback and your current IELTS band. Additionally, I will outline how we can work together to get to the next band.

During the last 2 years, I have been developing a method to improve IELTS writing scores. The writing classes are focused on the IELTS marking criteria which are task response, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource and grammar. The process I use for teaching writing is easy to understand, logical and will ensure you perform to the best of your ability on exam day. Several of my students have received Band 7+. 

Conversational English is very successful in allowing students to increase their fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation and confidence. I use TED talks, BBC, The Guardian and various other real life materials to create fun, personalised and creative lessons. Optional homework included. 

In 2016, I completed my CELTA qualification and achieved a Pass A grade, which demonstrates that I am perfectly qualified to teach adults to develop their language skills. I started teaching in 2011 and have taught in Europe, Asia and South America. 

I started teaching on Italki at the end of 2016 and love teaching students from around the world. Please look at all of the positive reviews at the bottom of the page and don’t hesitate to book a class.

Have a nice day :)

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation Course: Speaking and/or Writing 2025
pro_course_detail.description:
This course will prepare you for the IELTS speaking and writing exams and can be adapted based on your needs. It doesn't matter whether you are taking IELTS in one week, one month or one year. Many students are able to train themselves for the reading/listening parts of the test, but struggle to achieve the same scores in speaking and writing and I'm here to help you with that.

We will focus on the most common topics that you will be tested on in the IELTS and work on all of the sub skills, to make sure you get the score you deserve. I have trained students who achieved between Band 7-9 for speaking/writing and know that my method works.

In addition, you will receive one google document each class with a model answer, extra advice and vocabulary for IELTS writing. You will then follow this document to write your own high level answer to a real IELTS question, which I will check during the next class.

In particular I put a strong focus on teaching:

1) Idiomatic language
2) Precise pronunciation
3) Range of advanced vocabulary 
4) Structure
5) Fluency
6) Phrasal Verbs

It is also possible to focus on writing for half of the class and speaking for the other half. If you have any further questions, please feel free to message me.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate to Advanced English (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you ever feel like your English is stuck at the same level and you'd like to go a little bit further? Would you like something that is more than just a conversation class? 

This fully-flexible course is designed to help with the common problems faced by intermediate and advanced learners. 

Together, we will identify your strengths and weaknesses in the first class and will then create a plan to take your English to the next level. 

Here are some of those common issues that I help students with:
-Correcting your pronunciation including individual sounds and intonation
-Teaching you how to speak fluently and without fear
- Enhancing your vocabulary across a wide range of topics
-Fixing common grammatical errors and expanding your grammatical range
-Teaching students how to think critically about the world
-Demonstrating clear structures to improve your written English 
-Preparing for job/university interviews and CV's/motivation letters  

If you have always been wanting to improve your level and have never known how to do, this is the course that you have been looking for!

pro_course_detail.title: OFFLINE-IELTS Writing Task 2 Essentials Video Course and E-book
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you struggling to understand the different types of questions in IELTS Writing task 2? Would you like to learn from model answers and have them explained to you sentence by sentence from an IELTS expert? 

This course includes a short book (16 pages)  with the most important information for IELTS task 2. What makes this unique is that each of the 7 units comes with a video of between 10 and 15 minutes to give you some essential tips and tricks, particularly to improve your task response, and coherence and cohesion.

This means that within 2 or 3 hours, you'll have the most important information to start writing IELTS tasks with confidence or you could even use this to revise key concepts just before the exam. 

Chapter 1-How to Write a One Idea Paragraph 
Chapter 2-Opinion Essays
Chapter 3-How to Write a Two Idea Paragraph 
Chapter 4-Discussion Essays
Chapter 5-Two-Part Questions
Chapter 6-Advantages and Disadvantages
Chapter 7-Problem and Solution 

This course is the ideal complement for my online classes and would work perfectly with the editing and grading service too. Alternatively, you can just watch the video course to learn the essential skills for IELTS. Literally, in 90 minutes, you could have a great understanding of the different structures and question types. 

This is a brand new course for 2023, but I've already given some of my current students the videos to learn from and they have loved them! 

Please book any available time in my schedule and as soon as I accept your request, I'll send you the book and videos :) 

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to ask! 

Please note that the book and videos are for personal use only and may not be shared without my permission.

pro_course_detail.description:
Are you presenting a report in front of your fellow classmates? Do you have a team project that must be presented to your bosses and colleagues? Are you giving a speech in front of a group of strangers? Are you nervous? Don't be! I can help. 

I have personally been taking public speaking courses for over 15 years and I would love to share some tips of the trade with you. I have experience with speaking in front of small groups of a few dozen, to even up to a few thousand people. It may be daunting, but it can be done, and even done in a way that captivates your audience!

The course includes: 

1. Reviewing your speech, checking for places where your English can match what you are presenting. Overly formal and overly casual can negatively affect your speech. 

2. Correcting any grammar or pronunciation problems.

3. Fine tuning your presentation skills. This would include points such as, Interest Arousing Introduction, Modulation, Fluent Delivery, Appropriate Pausing, Gestures and Facial Expressions, Naturalness, Poise, Use of a Microphone, Conversational Manner, Use of an Outline and many more. 

Let me help you turn your weaknesses into your strengths. The skills you learn in this class will not only help you with next weeks presentation but also give you the confidence to take up any assignment your boss hands to you, even if it's last minute! 

I look forward to working with you!

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I design each lesson based on the student's needs. 

For this, I ask for areas that they hold a specific interest (eg hobbies, academic pursuits, industry  etc), then will look for material around this area. 

This way we build conversational classes - which ALWAYS have CORRECTION & REVISION of learned terms - around areas that the student has an interest in.

By using this method, the student gets LANGUAGE INPUT, in homework, before the class, & then review during, followed by review in the next class. 

Together with conversation-with-correction, this combination produces fast & effective results in language acquisition.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I am a big believer in conversational classes, but these will ALWAYS come with a structure, and a focus on LANGUAGE ACQUISITION, not just a friendly chat! 

I ALWAYS give CORRECTION, & keep records of the vocabulary & language that has come up, send these to the student, and begin each class with short (fun!) tests.

This repetition is how the mind learns, and in all my time teaching, this method has proved the fastest and most efficient way for success.

pro_course_detail.title: Fast Track English!!! Join The A2 To B2 Language Gym Classes
pro_course_detail.description:
These are classes i've designed specifically to drill the fundamentals of English, and practise regularly occurring vocabulary, in different contexts. 

We will work through a 3000 word vocabulary list, that makes up the fundamentals of English, by exploring their meaning, presenting new sentences with them, forming your own and then your doing HW of fill-the-gap tasks of the new words. 

This method of key-word focus, combined with reading and forming new sentences with them is highly effective in learning the fundamentals of English, and is a great way to improve quickly. 

As always in my classes, REVIEW is vital, as is simple homework tasks. I will of course correct pronunciation. The grammar is contained within the sentences, and you will learn in context, which is the most EFFICIENT way to learn. 

For fast results, it's best to use these classes frequently, and in shorter lesson times. Ideally 3 classes a week, of 30 or 45 mins. If you follow this method & do the hometasks, you will see FAST IMPROVEMENTS in your journey towards fluency. 

For students of this level, if you are RESULTS DRIVEN and prepared to work, you will benefit far more from this approach than the standard conversation with correction model.

Practice test components will be provided to students, who will receive detailed feedback on the strengths and weaknesses of their responses. pro_course_detail.description: Lessons feature a wide range of challenging and topical content, featuring exercises and discussion of the essential components of the subject. Other important elements of the subject, such as deductive and inductive arguments, and fallacies, are covered in depth.  Lessons also incorporate reading texts and associated writing tasks to develop a student's ability to identify key features of an argument, analyse and evaluate strengths and weaknesses, and produce a more critically sound version.  The lessons are not only aimed at developing a student's critical thinking skills but also their general academic ability.  Materials are adapted from a variety of published textbooks and coursebooks in the field.

Supplementary exercises and worksheets that follow-on from discussions are also available when appropriate.
